   199    199    def _plain_int(value: str) -> int:
   200        -      """Parse an int only if it is only ASCII digits and ``-``.
          200 +      """Parse an int made only of ASCII digits and an optional leading ``-``.
   201    201    
   202        -      This disallows ``+``, ``_``, and non-ASCII digits, which are accepted by ``int`` but
   203        -      are not allowed in HTTP header values.
          202 +      ``int`` also accepts ``+``, ``_`` and non-ASCII digits, which are not allowed in HTTP
          203 +      header values, so those are rejected with ``ValueError``.
   204    204    
   205        -      Any leading or trailing whitespace is stripped
          205 +      Leading and trailing spaces and tabs are stripped first.
   206    206        """
   207    207        value = value.strip(" \t")
   208    208        if _plain_int_re.fullmatch(value) is None:
